project_type: Native Android app (Kotlin), single-module Gradle project
build_system: Gradle with Kotlin DSL wrapper; groovy build.gradle; compileSdk 34, minSdk 24. ViewBinding enabled. No unit tests present in the project.
test_framework: None found in project — no test source sets configured
verification_instructions: Run `.\gradlew.bat assembleDebug` from `c:\Users\GAMING\Downloads\raaa\e-commerce-backend-main\hookaDrop App\HookahDrop`. Expect BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Then manually test on device/emulator: (1) Home page no longer shows top-right 'View All' TextViews; (2) 'View All Categories' button appears below category grid and opens CategoriesActivity; (3) 'View All Products' button appears below Popular Products RecyclerView and opens PopularProductsActivity; (4) PopularProductsActivity loads products in a 2-column grid with images, prices, favorite and add-to-cart buttons working.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Gradle wrapper is gradlew.bat. Project uses Firebase Google Services but no google-services.json issue was seen. Backend server must be running for product API calls; fallback to DataProvider static data is already coded.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns exactly: ViewBinding, coroutines with Dispatchers.Main/IO, LocaleManager.wrap in attachBaseContext, CartManager/FavoritesManager.init in onCreate, overridePendingTransition for all navigation.
key_patterns: Every Activity: (1) overrides attachBaseContext with LocaleManager.wrap(base), (2) uses ViewBinding via ActivityXxxBinding.inflate(layoutInflater), (3) calls CartManager.init(this) and FavoritesManager.init(this) in onCreate, (4) registers/removes cartListener in onCreate/onDestroy, (5) uses BottomNavManager for bottom navigation, (6) uses overridePendingTransition(R.anim.nav_enter, R.anim.nav_exit) for forward navigation and (R.anim.nav_back_enter, R.anim.nav_back_exit) for back. ProductAdapter takes (products, onProductClick, onFavoriteChanged, onCartChanged) and has updateProducts(). RemoteDataProvider.getPopularProducts() exists, calls /api/products/popular, falls back to DataProvider.products.take(6).
directory_structure: HookahDrop/ — root. app/src/main/java/com/hookahdrop/app/ — all Activity .kt files at root of this package; adapter/ — RecyclerView adapters; data/ — Models.kt, RemoteDataProvider.kt, DataProvider.kt, CartManager.kt, FavoritesManager.kt, SessionManager.kt; network/ — ApiClient.kt, ApiModels.kt; ui/ — BottomNavManager.kt. app/src/main/res/layout/ — all XML layouts. app/src/main/res/drawable/ — all XML and PNG drawables. app/src/main/res/anim/ — transition animations. app/src/main/res/values/ — colors.xml, themes.xml, strings.xml.
